headline: Executive order creates a federal council on criminal groups that operate across national borders.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new body called the United States Council on Transnational Organized Crime. Based on its title, the council is meant to bring federal officials together on crime networks that work across countries. No summary was provided, so details about who sits on the council and what it must do are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle law enforcement and national security
who_it_affects.how: They would take part in or coordinate through the new council on cross-border organized crime.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 15, 2021; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
